purpose: Collect a balanced same-operator Real96 Task1 bank with a predeclared nested Real48 subset.

frozen_distribution.cells: 12 cells, eight plan items per cell
frozen_distribution.Real48: 48 fixed plan members: 24 center, 24 offset, yaw 24/24, quadrants six each
frozen_distribution.Real96: 96 fixed plan members: 48 center, 48 offset, yaw 48/48, quadrants twelve each
frozen_distribution.nested_subset: Real48 is the strict predeclared 48-plan-item subset of Real96; it is not the first 48 chronological successes.
frozen_distribution.nominal_pose_note: There are 96 unique plan items but 72 unique nominal x/y/yaw tuples because center/yaw repetitions are intentional.
frozen_distribution.source_designs: Center placement follows the prior Real24 collection; +/-15 mm quadrants and yaw 0/45 balance follow the frozen Quest-Sim48-v7 pose-bank design.

session_design.members: Real48 center yaw0 plus extension Q((i+3) mod4) yaw45
Real48 Q((i+2) mod4) yaw45 plus extension center yaw0 repetition
Real48 center yaw45 plus extension Q((i+1) mod4) yaw0
Real48 Q(i mod4) yaw0 plus extension center yaw45 repetition

data_contract.observation_state: float32[6] pre-action state in Real dataset units
data_contract.action: float32[6] actual command sent to the follower
data_contract.failed_attempts: retained separately with original outcome and excluded from the accepted-success subset

interaction_dependency.reason: Leader-follower collection declares its own control source and does not fabricate Quest-only target fields.

freeze_outputs_after_collection: immutable raw tree inventory and SHA-256
